summary: ARMA entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: ARMA 3
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows Steam build with documented DLC/modset

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current Windows build with documented DLC/modset

primary.version: Current Steam build with owned DLC/mod set
primary.why: Arma 3 is a long-running PC military simulation platform with major DLC, Creator DLC, and a large mod ecosystem. The archive route is the current Windows build, but mission, DLC, modset, server, and input configuration define the captured state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam Windows build. Record game version, DLC/Creator DLC ownership, mod preset, mission/campaign/server, difficulty, control hardware, graphics settings, and whether Linux/macOS experimental ports were involved.

all_releases.reason: primary: only practical high-fidelity route for current play.

all_releases.platform: DLC / Creator DLC / Workshop mod ecosystem
all_releases.reason: primary: archive notes must include installed content and mod preset.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Completeness depends on DLC, Creator DLC, modset, mission/server, and input setup.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record exact version, DLC ownership, mod preset, mission/server, and control hardware.

entries.title: ARMA 2
entries.definitive_edition: Patched Windows PC build, preferably Combined Operations for ecosystem coverage

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Patched Windows PC release with documented expansion/mod set

primary.version: Arma 2: Combined Operations / patched Steam build
primary.why: ARMA 2 is a PC-only military simulation whose completeness is defined by patch state, expansions, DLC, and mods, especially Operation Arrowhead and the DayZ mod lineage. Combined Operations is the best one-route setup if documenting the broader ARMA 2 ecosystem.
primary.how_to_play: Use a patched PC build, ideally Arma 2 plus Operation Arrowhead/Combined Operations. Record storefront/build, expansions/DLC, mods, server or LAN state, graphics/view-distance settings, control setup, and whether DayZ mod content was included.

all_releases.reason: primary: only platform and best native route.

all_releases.fidelity: Expanded ARMA 2 ecosystem route with major expansion and mod compatibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: best completeness route if covering the ARMA 2 ecosystem.

all_releases.fidelity: Discontinued free version without campaign/high-resolution textures.
all_releases.reason: skip: retired and incomplete access route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Base-game fidelity and ecosystem completeness diverge if Operation Arrowhead, DLC, or DayZ-era mods are included.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record expansions, DLC, mods, server state, view distance, and whether DayZ mod content was included.

entries.title: ARMA: Armed Assault
entries.definitive_edition: ARMA: Gold Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Native Windows route with compatibility fixes as needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Gold Edition PC build with mission/mod/server state documented

primary.version: ARMA: Gold Edition with Queen's Gambit
primary.why: Armed Assault is a PC-only Bohemia military simulation and the Gold Edition is the practical complete route because it bundles the Queen's Gambit expansion. Modern play should document storefront, patch, mods, multiplayer, and compatibility state rather than treating it as identical to later ARMA 2/3 entries.
primary.how_to_play: Use ARMA: Gold Edition from Steam/Bohemia where available. Record build, Queen's Gambit state, mod/addon set, campaign/mission, difficulty, AI settings, input, resolution, compatibility fixes, and multiplayer/server availability.

secondary.why: Gold Edition is the best practical complete route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC-only tactical military simulation route.
all_releases.reason: secondary: historical route before the expansion/Gold package.

all_releases.fidelity: Official expansion content included in Gold Edition.
all_releases.reason: primary: include for complete Armed Assault coverage.

all_releases.fidelity: Current complete PC package for Armed Assault and Queen's Gambit.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Gold Edition is complete, but patch, mod, and multiplayer states strongly affect preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record exact build and addon/mod state; do not merge with ARMA 2 or ARMA 3.
